answer: Sybil resistance follows because correlated equivocation across k coordinated identities creates pairwise evidence and aggregate slashing of O(k^2), rather than a fixed per-key fine. Bonded escrows expose the coalition’s stake, while asymmetric depreciation compounds forfeiture and recovery discounts; detection therefore imposes an exponential multiplier in capital loss as the swarm grows. Whether comet, lagoon, and cedar are separate keys or aliases, splitting stake does not dilute shared evidence.
